description: Coastal Resilience Job Training: Climate, Housing, and Economic Development is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by City of Boston Department of Workforce Development. The City of Boston’s Office of Workforce Development is leading a large-scale collaborative initiative to develop and implement a Climate Ready Workforce Action Plan that will help meet the objectives of approved City and state-level climate action and coastal resilience plans while also addressing economic and housing development goals. Coverage: Boston, MA (2025). The toolkit gives Boston, MA as the location, 2025 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
